prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: By the following autumn, the district had ______ its bus routes.

worlds.passage: Facing a budget gap in 2021, one rural school district reviewed the twelve bus routes that carried its students to class. It cut the three least-used routes and kept running the other nine itself, each along exactly the streets it had always followed, and the savings came entirely from paying fewer drivers and buying less fuel. By the following autumn, the district had ______ its bus routes.
worlds.explanation: The district cut its routes from twelve to nine, so it had "pared" them. "Privatized" fails because it kept running the remaining routes itself. "Redrawn" fails because each route followed exactly the streets it always had, and "monetized" fails because the savings came entirely from lower costs, not new income.

privatized.quote: kept running the other nine itself
privatized.why: the district still operated the routes

redrawn.quote: exactly the streets it had always followed
redrawn.why: the routes' paths did not change

monetized.quote: savings came entirely from paying fewer drivers
monetized.why: the district cut costs rather than earning money from the routes

worlds.passage: Facing a budget gap in 2021, one rural school district reviewed the twelve bus routes that carried its students to class. It handed all twelve routes, buses included, to a private company, which now owns and operates them along exactly the streets they had always followed, and the district pays that company a yearly fee for the service. By the following autumn, the district had ______ its bus routes.
worlds.explanation: The district transferred ownership and operation of the routes to a private company, so it had "privatized" them. "Pared" fails because all twelve routes remained. "Redrawn" fails because they followed exactly the streets they always had, and "monetized" fails because the district pays the company rather than earning money from the routes.

redrawn.quote: exactly the streets they had always followed
redrawn.why: the routes' paths did not change

monetized.why: money flows out of the district, not in

worlds.explanation: Each route now followed different streets, so the district had "redrawn" its routes. "Pared" fails because all twelve routes remained. "Privatized" fails because the district kept running them itself, and "monetized" fails because the savings came entirely from burning less fuel, not from new income.
